rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail baseline with a compact behavioral change: after each reverse tail recurrence pass, the tail anchor is nudged toward the refreshed state so shallower recurrent passes see a progressively updated anchor instead of a frozen decoder-output anchor. This targets the locally promising anchor-refresh category without adding export-heavy structure. I also fixed the chunked masked-loss accumulator so chunked eval/training paths sum all chunks correctly.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Drift
